Divergence -12-(100/9)x-10y<0 excludes periodic or closed connection loops, and the Poincare–Bendixson alternatives reduce each omega set to one of the at-most-three equilibria identified by P_a(x). With 0<a<a_+ the middle saddle stable manifold separates two sink basins; strong cooperativity inside 0<x<2 and the opposite-sign stable eigenvector gives a decreasing separatrix. At the fold a=a_+, center-manifold invariance yields dot u=A u^2+B u^3+O(u^4), A~1.8507800878575>0, B~-6.2318442921878, and for generic attracting fold trajectories w=1/(s-x) satisfies w=At+L log t+C+o(1) with L=-B/A~3.36714466136; exponential strong-stable exceptions are excluded. Analytic convergence relies on planar dynamics and center-manifold tracking, not finite iteration.
